user.current_work: Social media manager at a local agency

user_snapshot: Mass Comm grad, 2 years post-NYSC, running social media at a Lagos agency for ₦150k while sitting on ₦450k savings. JAPA-committed, single, low family pressure, high risk tolerance — you have runway most of your peers don't.
headline_insight: Your ₦150k agency salary is a floor you can abandon — with no dependents and ₦450k saved, the real question isn't survival but whether you burn 18 months building a USD-paying remote brand or use savings as JAPA down-payment. You cannot do both well.

routes.title: Remote Content Marketing / Social at Foreign Startup (USD)
routes.one_liner: Leverage your agency portfolio into a USD-paying remote role at a Western SaaS or creator-economy company within 9-12 months.

fit_reasons.note: Your social media management, content creation, video editing and writing stack is exactly what remote B2B SaaS and creator startups hire.
₦450k + ₦150k monthly buys you 6+ months of portfolio-building evenings without quitting the agency.

break_reasons.risk: Agency workload drains your evenings — 9 months pass with no personal portfolio, no inbound DMs, no offer.

routes.who_this_fits: Operators who ship in public, post weekly on LinkedIn/Twitter, and treat their own brand as their biggest client.
routes.who_this_breaks: People who wait to 'feel ready' and apply cold on LinkedIn to 200 jobs with no portfolio or audience.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Evenings and Saturdays for 6-9 months. Social life contracts. You keep the ₦150k job until the first USD offer lands.

real_pay.range_note: USD-pegged: entry ~$800/mo, mid ~$2k, senior $4-5k. Converted at ₦1,500/$. Naira figure swings with FX.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you execute, you're earning $2,000-2,500/mo (~₦3m) as a Content Lead at a Series A US or EU startup, working from a Lekki 1-bed, and funding your own Canada Express Entry or UK Global Talent application.
pro_tips: Ghostwrite 3 LinkedIn posts weekly for one SaaS founder free — referrals follow.
Package agency wins as case studies with real numbers on Notion.

job_sites.name: Contra
job_sites.why: Primary platform for remote content/social freelancers paying USD — profiles surface to Western founders.

job_sites.name: Wellfound
job_sites.why: Startup-heavy; remote content marketing roles at seed-to-Series B companies post here first.

job_sites.name: Remotive
job_sites.why: Curated remote board with strong marketing category — fewer scams than cold LinkedIn.

monday_actions.step: Rewrite LinkedIn headline to 'Content & Social for B2B SaaS | ex-[agency]' and post a case study of your best agency campaign with metrics.
Create Contra profile with 3 productised services (LinkedIn ghostwriting, short-form video edits, launch content) priced in USD.
DM 10 Nigerian remote content marketers on Twitter/X (Mark Essien, Victor Fatanmi alumni, Stears ex-staff) asking one specific question about their first USD client.

milestones: Quit agency when retainer hits ₦1m/mo net
Full-time Content Lead role at US/EU startup $2-2.5k/mo

routes.nigerian_notes: Get a Grey or Geegpay USD account before the first invoice. Use Pied Piper or a US LLC (Doola, ~$300) once monthly income crosses $2k to avoid Naira haircuts.

routes.title: Canada Express Entry via Marketing/Comms NOC
routes.one_liner: Stack 3 years of agency experience + IELTS + WES into a PR application as a Marketing Specialist (NOC 11202) by month 18.

fit_reasons.note: Your 'committed' JAPA appetite + 18-month horizon fits Express Entry's 6-12 month processing perfectly.
₦450k covers IELTS (₦150k), WES (₦120k), and first instalment of the ₦1.5-2m fee stack.

break_reasons.risk: CRS cut-offs for general draws sit at 500+ in 2026 — without category-based draws for marketing, you may sit in the pool unnoticed.

routes.who_this_fits: Disciplined test-takers who treat IELTS like JAMB — 3 months of daily practice, CLB 9 minimum.
routes.who_this_breaks: Applicants who skip French (NCLC 7 gives +50 CRS points) and rely on age/education alone.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: ₦2m+ of your USD earnings over 12 months. Mental bandwidth split between remote hustle and test prep.

real_pay.range_note: Canadian marketing specialist entry CAD $55-65k, mid $80-95k, senior $120k+. Converted at ₦1,100/CAD. Toronto/Vancouver higher; Prairies lower.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you clear IELTS CLB 9 and submit, you've either landed PR with a Confirmation of Permanent Residence and are job-hunting in Toronto on ₦3.5m-equivalent entry, or you're 3 months from ITA sitting on a 480 CRS score.
pro_tips: Write IELTS General, not Academic — it's easier and Express Entry accepts it.
Start French Duolingo at month 3 — TEF NCLC 7 adds 50 points.

monday_actions.step: Book IELTS General at British Council Lagos (Ikoyi) for a date 10-12 weeks out — cost ₦150,000.
Open WES Canada ECA file at wes.org/ca and request transcript from your private uni registrar.
Run free CRS calculator at cic.gc.ca — screenshot your score, identify the 2 weakest levers.

milestones: IELTS CLB 9 on all four bands
First marketing coordinator role at C$55-65k

routes.nigerian_notes: Use a registered Canadian immigration consultant (ICCRC-licensed) only — reject 'agents' promising guaranteed PR. ConnectSafe Nigeria on Twitter flags current scams.

routes.title: Build Your Own Content Brand (Creator / Small Agency)
routes.one_liner: Turn your video editing + writing into a personal brand that earns from brand deals, courses, and a 2-person productised agency by Year 2.

fit_reasons.note: Your 'high' risk tolerance + no dependents + low family pressure means you can tolerate 6-9 months of uneven income.
Video editing + social media management + writing is the exact triple-stack solo creators monetise in Nigeria.

break_reasons.risk: Solo creator burnout — posting daily while running client work kills consistency by month 4, audience stalls at 3-5k followers.

routes.who_this_fits: Founders who enjoy being on camera or writing in public, comfortable with public failure.
routes.who_this_breaks: Introverts who hate posting and secretly want a salary. The calendar eats you.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Steady ₦150k salary within 6-9 months. Weekends gone. You eat ramen for Q1-Q2.

real_pay.range_note: Highly variable. Nigerian creators with 20k engaged followers earn ₦500k-1.5m/mo via brand deals + services. Top 5% hit ₦3-8m.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you stay consistent, you're running a 2-person content studio from a Yaba co-working space, earning ₦1-1.5m/mo from 3 retainer clients + 1 Nigerian brand deal/quarter, with 15-25k followers on one platform.
pro_tips: Pick one niche (fintech content, afrobeats marketing, founder storytelling) — generalists die.
Sell a ₦50k Notion template or mini-course by month 4 to test audience willingness to pay.

job_sites.name: Techpoint Africa
job_sites.why: Nigerian founders here commission content + sponsor creator features — warm market for your first retainers.

job_sites.name: Zikoko / Big Cabal Media
job_sites.why: Freelance commissions and contributor slots convert into creator-brand visibility.

job_sites.name: Contra
job_sites.why: Productise 'done-for-you short-form video editing' as a ₦300-600k/mo retainer offer.

monday_actions.step: Pick your niche in one sentence and write it on Notion: '[Name] helps [who] with [what content].'
Post a 60-second intro video on TikTok, Instagram Reels and LinkedIn the same day — same script, 3 platforms.
DM 5 Nigerian fintech/SaaS founders (Mono, Bamboo, Chaka, Risevest, Cowrywise) offering to ghost-edit one video free for a testimonial.

routes.nigerian_notes: Register a business name with CAC (₦20k) before first brand deal — Nigerian brands withhold payment without an invoice from a registered entity.

routes.title: In-House Senior Social / Comms at Lagos Fintech
routes.one_liner: Jump from agency to in-house Senior Social Media Manager at a tier-1 Nigerian fintech at ₦450-700k/mo within 6 months.

fit_reasons.note: Agency social-media-manager experience is the exact background Paystack, Moniepoint, Kuda screen for on senior social roles.
You're already in Yaba — every major fintech HQ is within 45 minutes (VI, Ikoyi, Lekki).

break_reasons.risk: The in-house Naira ceiling (~₦700k) locks in your earning power and delays JAPA savings versus the USD route.

routes.who_this_fits: Operators who want structure, HMO, pension, and a Lagos LinkedIn brand before JAPA.
routes.who_this_breaks: Anyone who wants creative control — in-house comms is mostly brand-safe approvals and Slack threads.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Agency freedom. Some evenings to portfolio interviews. Three months of focused applications.

real_pay.range_note: Tier-1 fintech (Paystack, Flutterwave, Moniepoint) pays top of band; tier-2 (Kuda, Carbon, FairMoney) pays ₦350-550k at senior.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you land this, you're Senior Social Media Manager at Moniepoint or Kuda earning ₦650-800k/mo with HMO, managing a 2-person team, ₦4-6m saved, Canada PR application mid-flight.
pro_tips: Build a one-page deck of 3 fintech campaign ideas before each interview.
Apply Tuesdays — Nigerian fintech HR reviews applications in Monday sprints.

job_sites.name: MyJobMag

monday_actions.step: Build a 1-page PDF case study of your best agency campaign with reach, engagement, CAC-style metrics.
Apply to open Senior Social roles at Paystack, Moniepoint, Kuda, Flutterwave, Carbon via their career pages — 5 applications same day.
Message 3 current/ex fintech social managers on LinkedIn for 15-min coffee chats referencing a specific campaign they ran.

milestones: Promoted to Lead or senior IC
Canada or UK skilled worker application filed

routes.nigerian_notes: Negotiate HMO (Avon or Hygeia) and 13th month before signing — standard at tier-1 fintechs, often forgotten by first-time in-house hires.

routes_filtered_out.route: MSc in UK/Canada on the school route
routes_filtered_out.reason: Tuition + living costs ₦18-30m vastly exceed your ₦450k savings; would require 3-5 years of USD earnings first. Express Entry is cheaper and faster for your profile.

routes_filtered_out.route: Commission-heavy ad sales / FMCG field sales
routes_filtered_out.reason: Explicitly listed in your hard_nos (Commission-only sales). Also poor use of your content production stack.

routes_filtered_out.route: Tech bootcamp pivot (AltSchool, Decagon) into software engineering
routes_filtered_out.reason: Throws away 3 years of Mass Comm + agency leverage to start junior in a saturated 2026 market. Remote content marketing converts your existing skills to USD faster.

routes_filtered_out.route: Traditional PR agency senior hire (X3M Ideas, Insight Publicis)
routes_filtered_out.reason: Ceiling at ₦400-500k similar to fintech in-house but slower JAPA pipeline and weaker portable brand. Fintech route dominates it.
